subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should OpenClaw treat valid Claude CLI OAuth failing only under the managed cron/cli-backend service context as a core runtime bug to fix now, or as an unsupported host-service setup that should get recovery/docs only?
rationale: The reporter's evidence says direct Claude CLI and embedded Anthropic runs work, while OpenClaw's managed live-session path fails; choosing between runtime repair, diagnostics/recovery, or setup policy needs maintainer ownership of Claude CLI service semantics.

options.title: Fix as core runtime bug
options.body: Recommended: require live managed-service proof, then patch the narrow CLI env/session/auth boundary that makes a valid Claude CLI login fail under OpenClaw.

options.title: Limit to recovery guidance
options.body: Let the related 401 re-auth guidance work proceed, but leave this issue open or close only after maintainers decide valid-service-context Claude CLI OAuth is not supported.

options.title: Document unsupported service setup
options.body: If LaunchAgent or service-context Claude CLI OAuth is intentionally unsupported, document the expected Anthropic API-key path and close with that policy.

recommendation.title: Fix as core runtime bug
recommendation.body: Recommended: require live managed-service proof, then patch the narrow CLI env/session/auth boundary that makes a valid Claude CLI login fail under OpenClaw.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the Claude CLI backend, API-error surfacing, and gateway auth env hardening points to steipete.
